events.description: EOSP. Vessel at Ravenna pilot station.
Vessel arrived at anchorage. Berth occupied by MV SANTA ELENA.
NOR tendered to Coop Agricola Ravenna. Berth congestion noted.
Vessel at anchor — berth not available. WIBON clause: time counts from NOR.
Tug NETTUNO PRIMO ordered. 45-min delay due to LNG terminal commitment.
First line ashore. All fast at Berth 12.
Discharging commenced. Shore grab cranes operational.
Grab crane #2 broke down — hydraulic pump failure. Discharging rate reduced 50%.
Crane #2 repaired and operational. Full discharging rate restored.
Pilot on board. Last line let go.

notes: Med discharge with berth congestion (WIBON — time counts from NOR), tugboat delay, and shore-equipment breakdown. CP addendum cl.47 holds breakdown counts as laytime. 56.75h used vs 60h allowed — minor despatch 3.25h. No demurrage triggered.
